about: Warnings: issued (when made or first read), in_force (type, level, area, start, end: IPMA), cap (IPMA's own CAP messages for Lisbon: at is when IPMA sent it; an Update names the message it replaces) and history (the meteorologist's record of when each was first seen). Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.

rows.text: IPMA communiqué no. 1 names the low CHARLES; says orange warnings will be issued for the mainland, an upgrade not ruled out; worse weather 'a partir do final da manhã do dia 11'.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: ANEPC public warning Aviso 21 on CHARLES (gusts to 120 km/h; avoid unnecessary travel). Civil protection's, not IPMA's.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA's warnings update 'divulgada às 08h31 de terça-feira': red wind for eight mainland districts on Wednesday; Lisbon red wind 12:00 to 21:00, gusts to 120 km/h, up to 140 km/h in the most exposed places (Lusa, as published by AWAY at 08:46 UTC). The first public time for Lisbon's red wind found so far.
rows.label: evidence

rows.text: The government's alert situation for the mainland on Wednesday cites IPMA: gusts that may reach 120 km/h and, if a sting jet forms, above 150 km/h.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA warnings read: Lisbon red wind Wed 12:00-21:00; rain orange Wed (05:00 onwards); sea orange Wed 12:00-21:00; a yellow sea warning added Wed 21:00-Thu 03:00.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA communiqué no. 2: worse weather on the mainland 'a partir do início da manhã do dia 11' (moved earlier from late morning); red and orange warnings issued; further upgrades not ruled out.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA raises Lisbon rain to RED Wed 12:00-18:00 (orange now 05:00-12:00 only). First read at 17:42.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: first read by this desk: Lisbon's non-green warnings as in `lisbon`
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA sends a wind warning message for Lisboa (CAP id ...PT.261109132716.PO-01-1906), the one the red wind later replaced; its level is not in the feed any more (superseded).
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA SENDS the RED wind warning for Lisboa, Wed 12:00-21:00 (CAP id ...PO-01-1915, an update of the 9 Nov 13:27:16 message). This is the issue time; press reported it from 08:31.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA sends the ORANGE sea warning for Lisboa, Wed 12:00-21:00 (update of a 07:18:40 message).
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA sends the message that made Lisbon's rain RED (12:00-18:00): its sent time, as named in the 21:23 update's references. Open data showed it between 16:52 and 17:42.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA sends updates for Lisboa: RED rain moved earlier to Wed 09:00-18:00 (was 12:00-18:00); ORANGE rain Wed 00:00-09:00 (was 05:00-12:00); YELLOW rain Tue 21:24-Wed 00:00.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA's open data (warnings_www.json) first shows the 21:23 change: it lagged the CAP messages by at least 2 h (reads at 22:04, 22:23 and 23:22 still had the old rain warnings).
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA LOWERS Lisbon's wind warning from RED to ORANGE: 'Aviso Laranja Vento', Wed 09:00-21:00, 'Rajadas até 120 km/h' (CAP Update replacing the red message PO-01-1915 sent 10 Nov 07:18:40). Setúbal lowered the same way at the same time. Red rain 09:00-18:00 unchanged. IPMA's open data still showed red wind at 07:38.
rows.label: fact

rows.text: IPMA's open data first shows Lisbon's wind as ORANGE 09:00-21:00: it lagged the CAP message (sent 07:16:30) by between 66 and about 87 minutes (first read orange by incident.weatherwatch@ at 08:43).
rows.label: fact
